analysis: PRKD2 PSC and monocyte shared-signal analysis v1
selection_status: Requested after the existing rs313839 direction comparison; exploratory published-cohort reuse, no newly computed regional posteriors inspected
regional_rule: Exact Catalogue PRKD2 phenotype TSS +/- 1 Mb in both contexts, full nominal and published component evidence without significance filtering

gwas.scope: Discovery GWAS, not the 4796-case combined replication sample or later fine-mapping run
gwas.other_platforms: Use source-specific N and case fraction from publisher Supplementary Table 1 from the outset; preserve original fields
gwas.effect_input: Primary marginal ABF uses reported P, control MAF and known case fraction; avoids assuming the undocumented scale of source SE accompanying OR
gwas.direction: For signed-z reference-LD sensitivity, use inverse-normal two-sided P and source risk-allele orientation; preserve original OR/SE separately

platform_count_provenance.affy_case_control_derivation: Published overall discovery case/control counts minus the explicitly labelled Omni columns; sum checked against Affy totals

alignment.variants: Biallelic single-nucleotide substitutions only; retain all excluded indels, duplicate conflicts and missing mappings in the audit
alignment.build: Unique reciprocal UCSC chain mapping, exact chromosome/position and allele set, explicit strand complement only from chain orientation
alignment.palindromic: Require exact coordinate/alleles plus GWAS risk/control-frequency versus reference EUR frequency difference <= 0.15; otherwise exclude
alignment.qtl: Exact GRCh38 REF/ALT; numeric Ensembl gene-version removal only; collapse rsID-only aliases, exclude conflicting rows
alignment.missing: Unavailable is never a null result; do not substitute LD proxies

methods.preferred: Signal-wise coloc using complete published SuSiE log Bayes factors or coherent signed LD with documented sample/allele provenance
methods.baseline: Official coloc 5.2.3 marginal ABFs using all eligible platforms with per-variant N and case fraction; quantitative beta/SE; unit and estimated sdY; single-causal baseline, not a substitute for multiple-signal analysis
methods.qtl_baseline: Reported beta and SE, quantitative trait, sdY=1 for inverse-normalized expression; sensitivity estimates sdY from MAF/SE/N
methods.reference_ld_sensitivity: Use complete published QTL component vectors as preferred evidence in both cohorts. A BLUEPRINT EUR-LD refit is an optional documented technical comparison if no published component exists; no EUR-LD DICE fit.
methods.ld_qc: Exact SNP/allele order; symmetric finite signed r, unit diagonal and PSD; preserve diagnostics, convergence and missing credible sets. No arbitrary ridge chosen for favorable results.
methods.coverage_gate: At least 100 shared variants and >=90% of full marginal BF weight in each trait. For each published and fitted component separately require >=90% full component posterior weight overlap. Report excluded non-SNV and low-MAF weight before asserting adequate coverage; all failures remain unavailable.
methods.interpretation: Strong statistical support requires H4>=0.9 at p12=1e-6 and >=0.8 at p12=1e-7 and 1e-5, passed coverage and consistent usable component comparisons across scalar-N sensitivities. External-LD and sample-covariance limits remain even if thresholds pass. Do not treat failure as proof of different biology.
methods.not_permitted: No multiplication by AlphaGenome scores, no favorable-track selection, no back-calculation of incomplete BF vectors from credible-set-only PIPs, no clinical or mediation claim
methods.published_qtl_components: Retrieve all published 95% credible sets and full per-component BF vectors for exactly PRKD2 in both contexts. Retain every source component, including failed overlap; do not infer full vectors from credible sets alone.
methods.gwas_signal_analysis: External signed 503-EUR reference LD SuSiE, all eligible platforms; scalar N 11386 primary with 3504 and 14890 sensitivities; these do not reconstruct exact overlapping-platform covariance. Preserve all fits and LD mismatch diagnostics.
methods.indels: Retain every source indel and quantify its marginal/component weight. Primary matching is biallelic SNVs; no single-base liftover of an indel, rsID-only rescue or proxy substitution. Material omitted weight makes complete-locus interpretation unavailable.

limits: Same public PSC discovery GWAS and reused BLUEPRINT/DICE cohorts; this is not independent discovery or a model validation
GWAS original signed in-sample LD and overlapping-platform covariance remain unavailable
DICE ancestry is not assumed matched to 503 EUR reference donors
No mediation, disease-progression, protein-activity or treatment-benefit claim
SNP matching does not establish coverage of excluded indels; full pre-intersection and published-component evidence gates remain mandatory
